name: BusinessMoveRelocationOrders
tagline: Move business customers to a new site without an outage – survey, order, install, port, dual running and cease in one app.
description: A complete B2B fulfilment app for telecom operators in one Power Apps code component: business move orders from capture through site survey, ordering, install booking, go-live and dual running to completion, with lead time checks, number porting, dual running cost against an allowance and a no-outage cutover planner that writes a customer cutover notice.
features: No-outage cutover planner with live plan checks
Lead time jeopardy against the customer move date
Number porting status, dates and blocking rules
Dual running cost and overrun against an allowance
MRC change and one-off charges per move
Pipeline board with rule-checked drag and drop
Timeline with provisioning, dual running, outage gaps and markers
Bulk coordinator / priority / hold, CSV export, undo
Demo mode, phone layout, keyboard and ARIA
